newsitem.title: UK: UK shares advance amid short squeeze.
newsitem.headline: UK shares advance amid short squeeze.

text.p: The UK's leading blue chip shares advanced at the open on Tuesday on what dealers described as a low-volume short squeeze.
At 0748 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 share index was up 41.2 points to 4,936.9, as advancers broadly beat decliners 84 to six.
They said the lack of bad news on the corporate front precipitated the unexpected rally.
"Everyone's results met expectations. Even NatWest's numbers weren't particularly poor," said one dealer.
